description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian Chinese female in her late 60s, with short, permed silver-grey hair, wearing a loose-fitting floral patterned blouse and comfortable dark blue cotton trousers with practical sandals. She is a full-bodied figure from head to toe.

FULL BODY. An anonymous and featureless human figure dressed in a matte black oversized hoodie and black cargo pants. The face is a void of darkness, and the figure wears thin glowing red lines on their wrists to indicate their technological nature.

FULL BODY. A professional Malaysian male in his 30s, short neat hair, wearing a crisp dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with a peaked cap and polished black boots. He is a full-bodied figure from head to toe.

FULL BODY. A featureless AI-robot-like silhouette composed of digital static and glitching blue pixels. The figure is seated in a stiff posture, lacking facial features or human skin texture, symbolizing a remote presence.
